# BoardTAU - Boarding House & Student Housing Platform for Tarlac Agricultural University (TAU)

> BoardTAU is the official trusted housing platform for the Tarlac Agricultural University community in Camiling, Tarlac, Philippines. We provide a seamless, secure, and verified way for students and faculty to discover, compare, and reserve boarding houses, dormitories, and apartments.

## Core Features
- **4-Phase Search Wizard**: Search by TAU College proximity, room budget, bed setups, and verified amenities.
- **Kerby AI Assistant**: AI-powered housing assistant providing distance breakdowns, room availability, and FAQ guidance.
- **Digital Lease Signing**: Review and digitally sign official lease contracts directly on the platform.
- **Biometric KYC Verification**: Identity verification for tenants and host safety.
- **Verified Host Listings**: All properties are verified by platform administrators.
